AI summary (please check the original press releases for accurate information)

Hanno Summer Solstice Festival Beer Garden (Forest, Water, and Sun) will be held. See the press release (PDF) for details.

Hanno City has established guidelines for its free-theme private proposal system and will accept public applications for private proposals related to comprehensive facility management operations. See the press release (PDF) for details.

The investigation report (public version) on a serious bullying incident has been published. See the press release (PDF) for details.

A market sounding survey will be conducted regarding the use of the former Mukaihara housing complex site. See the press release and sounding implementation guidelines (PDF) for details.

Hanno City implements no-necktie practices year-round. See the press release (PDF) for details.

Hanno City received a donation from Ome Shinkin Bank. See the press release (PDF) for details.

The Arima area water source forest conservation project (nicknamed the "Hawk Eagle and Japanese Dormouse Forest Project") has launched. See the press release (PDF) for details.

A donation presentation ceremony was held from Hanno Rotary Club to Hanno City. See the press release (PDF) for details.

Hanno City received a donation from MX Mobiling Co., Ltd. through the Corporate Hometown Tax program. See the press release (PDF) for details.
